name: Sailor Moon Dating Simulator: Moon Maid
source:
The goal of the game is to win love of Usagi Tsukino by asking her out on dates, giving her gifts or playing mini-games.

Usagi's outfit is inspired by ep.#193.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130116034308/http://www.sailorvgame.org/mg/smds/smds_maid.htm]Sailorvgame.org[/url]]
